title: Interview with a 101-Year-Old
description: Learn about the life, memories, and secrets of a woman who is 101 years old.

sources.citation: Video auf YouTube; Aufgaben erstellt mit KI-Unterstützung, redaktionell geprüft.

transcript:
Capitolo 1: Introductions
0:000 secondi- Did you have forks or knives in the old days? - Forks and knives? Oh, sure, and spoons.
0:088 secondi(lighthearted music) Hello. - Hi.
Capitolo 2: Age and background
0:1717 secondi- Hi, Micah. - Hi. - I'm Alice. - Nice to meet you, Malice. - Alice. - Alice, oh, sorry. - What is your name?
0:2525 secondi- Clara. - Clara? I'm very happy to meet you. - What are we here to talk about? - Well, I think it might be how old I am.
0:3535 secondi- How old are you? - I'm in my hundred and first year.
0:3939 secondi101. (gasps) - 101? - Right. Did you ever know anybody else that old?
0:4949 secondi- No. - I don't even know anybody else that old. - Where are you from?
Capitolo 3: Life in the old days
0:5454 secondi- Well, originally, I was born in Philadelphia, way, way over on the east coast. - I was born in New York City.
1:031 minuto e 3 secondi- Oh, you were? So, you were born in the east too. - Yeah. - How was it like back then?
1:111 minuto e 11 secondi- We didn't have radio, we didn't have television. No telephones, when I was a little girl.
1:191 minuto e 19 secondiThere were not any trucks. They had wagons, and horses pulled them. - Wow, that must've been a long time ago.
1:271 minuto e 27 secondi- It was a long, long time ago. - Back then, did you see any wars? - I did, and I was in the war.
Capitolo 4: Wartime experience
1:361 minuto e 36 secondiI was in the second World War.
1:381 minuto e 38 secondiWe worked on decoding and encoding machines, very secret work.
1:441 minuto e 44 secondiThe officers had guns, and they said, if you told any of the secrets, they would shoot you dead.
1:551 minuto e 55 secondiBut nobody got shot. - Good then. - Yeah. - What would you do for fun? - Oh, when I was a little girl?
Capitolo 5: Childhood and gender roles
2:032 minuti e 3 secondiI had dolls and blocks. But I really liked boys' things. I liked marbles and tops.
2:112 minuti e 11 secondiAnd I thought boys were much luckier than girls.
2:142 minuti e 14 secondiWe had to wear skirts and stockings, even in the coldest weather. They didn't have slacks or pants for girls.
2:232 minuti e 23 secondi- Girls couldn't wear pants? - That's true. - That is not fair. - No. - What is your job?
Capitolo 6: Career as a teacher
2:312 minuti e 31 secondi- Oh, my job was teaching in a college. But I retired a long time ago. And I taught biology.
2:392 minuti e 39 secondiAnd if you look at my shirt, you'll see some of the things I've taught about. Could you possibly know what this one is?
2:472 minuti e 47 secondi- [Micah] Oh, that's a spider. - Well, wonderful. - What's your favorite insect? - Ants, I did research on ants.
2:552 minuti e 55 secondiBut you know what an ant looks like, don't you? - Yeah, it's like this tiny. They can carry a big thing, like a banana.
3:053 minuti e 5 secondiLike, three of them can, even though they're this tiny. - You're very good, and you're only six years old? - What do you like to do for fun?
Capitolo 7: Daily routine and health
3:133 minuti e 13 secondi- Well, right now, I'm watching the Olympics. And I write books, I do puzzles. I enjoy email, I write to a lot of friends.
3:233 minuti e 23 secondiI even play Scrabble, do you know how to play Scrabble? No? - No. - You should ask somebody to play Scrabble.
3:313 minuti e 31 secondiIt's lots of fun. Also, I try to get exercise every day. - Every day? - Yep. - Good.
3:393 minuti e 39 secondi- Some old people aren't very well anymore.
3:433 minuti e 43 secondi- Yeah. - Some of them can't remember things.
3:463 minuti e 46 secondiSome of them are really lame, and they have to have somebody help them. But I can do everything myself. - That's good. - And that's good.
Capitolo 8: Challenges of longevity
3:553 minuti e 55 secondi- And that means you're really old, but you're really good at it. - Yeah, and I enjoy life.
4:034 minuti e 3 secondi- What is the hardest part about getting old? - You miss people.
4:084 minuti e 8 secondiAnd especially when you live over 100 years, most of the people I ever knew, in my family, are already dead.
4:164 minuti e 16 secondiBut that happens, doesn't it? - Yeah, a person in my family died. - And did you know the person?
4:244 minuti e 24 secondi- Yeah, it's my great grandfather.
4:274 minuti e 27 secondiAnd we still have a picture of him up on our mantel to remind us of when I was playing with him.
4:364 minuti e 36 secondi- That's wonderful. - Are you afraid of dying? - No, I'm not afraid of dying. I feel very healthy and happy.
Capitolo 9: Secrets to a long life
4:434 minuti e 43 secondiMy doctor said, "Maybe you'll just die in your sleep." (chuckles) So, I'm not afraid 'cause I have a good life.
4:524 minuti e 52 secondi- What's the secret to living a long life?
4:564 minuti e 56 secondi- Being happy, working hard, getting exercise, doing things for yourself, not expecting other people to do everything for you.
5:075 minuti e 7 secondiAnd all of those things make you live a long time. - Nice to meet you. - It's wonderful to meet you.
5:155 minuti e 15 secondiHave a great life. I'm very proud of you. - Thank you. - You're welcome. - [Girl] Nice to meet you.

warmup: Discuss with students what life might have been like 100 years ago without modern technology like smartphones or television.
steps: 1. Pre-teach key vocabulary related to history and aging.
2. First listening for global understanding and general mood (Questions 1 to 4).
3. Second listening for specific details about her childhood, career, and daily life (Questions 5 to 10).
4. Third listening for exact statements and deeper comprehension (Questions 11 to 13).
tips: Encourage students to listen closely to how everyday life has changed from her childhood to modern times.
followUp: Ask students to write down three questions they would ask a 100-year-old person if they had the chance.

questions.prompt: After listening: What do you think is the most important secret to a long and happy life? Write 2 to 3 sentences.
questions.explanation: Students formulate their own thoughts on longevity in English based on the themes of the interview.
questions.modelAnswer: I think staying active and having a positive attitude are very important. Being independent and enjoying small daily activities also help people live longer.
